name: the-museum
_: No "type": "module" here on purpose. Every harness in this repo is a .mjs and is ESM whatever this says, but declaring the package a module turns the prototype's own puzzles.js into ESM too, and mockups/elmorian-exhibit/test.mjs requires it. That broke the prototype's twenty checks silently, because nothing ran them.
description: The browser harnesses: the exported web build booted and played to its end, the prototype played to its end, its art rendered to files.
